description: Exact storage and persistence semantics for guild or clan membership remain unverified.
Rank/permission model and command authorization rules are not fully verified.
Exact party XP, loot, and reward sharing formulas and rounding remain unverified.
Disconnect, death, leader change, and disband edge cases remain unresolved.
Recipient scope, filtering, paging, and channel semantics remain partially inferred.
Exact alignment/reputation/faction effects and thresholds remain unresolved.
Ignore/mute/ban/social visibility flags require runtime evidence.
Guild hall/room/service integration needs cross-checking against world and NPC records.
